fields.title: Junior Frontend Developer (React)
fields.description: Build modern web applications with your team using React, TypeScript, and shared design systems.
fields.requirements: Strong HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals. Comfortable with React or another SPA framework. Git. Uzbek or English fluency.

fields.title: Middle React + TypeScript Developer
fields.description: Grow reliable frontend experiences for domestic and international customers—paired with pragmatic delivery discipline.
fields.requirements: 3+ years with React. TypeScript, REST APIs, state management (Redux or Zustand). Strong code-review culture.

fields.title: Python / Django Backend Developer
fields.description: Own payment and reconciliation services powering multiple products—Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, and async workloads where needed.
fields.requirements: Python expertise with Django or FastAPI. SQL literacy and thoughtful REST design. Celery or similar queues are a plus.

fields.title: Junior Backend Developer (Node.js)
fields.description: Ship pragmatic APIs alongside a compact, fast-moving team focused on iterative releases.
fields.requirements: JavaScript/TypeScript proficiency and Node fundamentals. Comfortable with Express or Nest-style patterns and JSON-heavy APIs.

fields.title: Full Stack Developer (Django + React)
fields.description: Expand an educational platform spanning admin dashboards, learner experiences, and reporting workflows.
fields.requirements: Django REST paired with React. PostgreSQL familiarity. Comfortable shipping through Docker-backed environments.

fields.title: Flutter Mobile Developer
fields.description: Deliver consumer-grade Flutter builds for Android and iOS from a unified codebase backed by disciplined QA.
fields.requirements: Dart mastery, Flutter toolkit fluency, and confident REST integrations. Published store experience strongly preferred.

fields.title: Junior Flutter Developer
fields.description: Support healthcare product modules—from intake flows to clinician tooling—paired with mentorship from senior teammates.
fields.requirements: Foundation-level Flutter comprehension: widgets, layout, and introductory state-management patterns.

fields.title: DevOps Engineer (AWS / Linux)
fields.description: Automate deployments, tighten observability, and keep baseline infrastructure reproducible.
fields.requirements: Linux administration, Docker, and CI tooling (GitHub Actions or GitLab CI). Exposure to AWS or comparable clouds plus Bash/Python scripting.

fields.title: UI/UX Designer
fields.description: Own product UX from discovery to high-fidelity Figma handoffs with tight collaboration alongside engineering partners.
fields.requirements: Confident Figma workflows, interactive prototypes, and core UX heuristics. Portfolio review is part of the process.

fields.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python)
fields.description: Architect high-throughput services, streaming data paths, and internal libraries that other teams depend on daily.
fields.requirements: 5+ years shipping Python in production. System design depth, PostgreSQL performance tuning, and meaningful automated test coverage.
